name: Skeuomorphic
description: Physical material: small machined corners, crisp outlines in the strong border color, rules raised as a strong stitched ridge, a bright 2px top bevel, a dark 2px under-edge, a firm contact shadow and a soft drop, wells pressed in from above, presses that sink a pixel, and calm eased motion.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's skeuomorphic recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: A decorative gradient texture sits behind surfaces.

tokens.shadow-card: inset 0 2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 90%, transparent), inset 0 -2px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 28%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 45%, transparent), 0 8px 18px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 34%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-overlay: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 70%, transparent), 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 30%, transparent), 0 12px 28px -4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 28%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 90%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 14%, transparent), 0 2px 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 35%, transparent), 0 14px 28px -6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shadow) 30%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-inset: inset 0 2px 4px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 28%, transparent), inset 0 -1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 60%, transparent)
tokens.texture: radial-gradient(circle, color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 12%, transparent) 0 0.5px, transparent 0.75px)
